title: Closed offline package catalog (runners/rust/catalog/catalog.json, runners/php/catalog/catalog.json, and the python-data catalog that feature 024 supplies)
description: Feature 023 draft. A catalog is reviewed source in the repository, copied into the builder image and embedded in crates/infra-schema; the SHA-256 of its canonical bytes is the catalog digest of the toolchain identity. Adding, removing or changing an entry requires review and a new image digest. Audit evidence is a statement about the image build, not a permanent claim (G1205). For rust and php the catalog is copied into the builder image and the packages travel in the artifact; for the image-catalog runtime python-data (FR-023-027) the packages are installed in the runtime image and artifacts bind this digest in runtimeCatalog; feature 024 owns that file's location and content, this schema owns its shape.

rustc.description: Rust only: the compiler the prebuilt libraries were built with; must equal the builder's.

python.description: python-data only: the interpreter version of the runtime image.

phpExtensions.description: PHP only: the closed extension set of the runtime image.

additionalProperties.description: SHA-256 of the wheel for that target, as written in the hash-pinned requirements lock.

packageType.description: composer-plugin and metapackage are not admitted.

archiveSha256.description: Independently computed at image build over the downloaded archive.

dependencies.description: Exact names of catalog entries this entry needs; the closure is computed from these.

buildScript.description: Rust: has build.rs, run only when the image is built, never in a customer build.

procMacro.description: Rust: proc-macro library. Review evidence only: rustc loads it from the read-only image and runs its reviewed code inside the sandboxed builder container on every customer build that uses it (D1228).

autoloadFiles.description: PHP: declares autoload.files, which run when the autoloader loads (G1214).

requiresExtensions.description: PHP: must be a subset of phpExtensions.

advisoryAudit.description: Tool and database snapshot used at image build, e.g. cargo-audit with a RustSec snapshot date or composer audit.
